errors.evidence: The description states there are five methods, but the plot and legend clearly show six. The method 'IKE' (red line with upward-pointing triangles) is completely omitted from the description.

The x-axis data points do not range from 1 to 1000. The first data point is located at approximately 5 on the logarithmic scale, and the last data point is located at a value greater than 1000 (10^3).
The first data points for all methods are not at a co-occurrence number of 1. On the logarithmic x-axis, these points are located at approximately 5.
The last data points for all methods are not at a co-occurrence number of 1000. On the logarithmic x-axis, these points are located at a value greater than 10^3 (1000).

The description for the 'FT' method's marker is underspecified. The markers are specifically downward-pointing triangles, which distinguishes them from the 'IKE' method's upward-pointing triangles (which was omitted entirely).
At the lowest co-occurrence number, the accuracy for the FT method is approximately 65.5%, not 65%.
